Uses only the public Robot client, calibrated RGB/depth and proprioception.
Commands and observations are retained for the trajectory record.

import json, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output')
def fk(q, extra=.1034):
    T=np.eye(4)
    for ai,di,alpha,qi in zip([0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088],[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,.107],[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2],q):
        X=np.eye(4); X[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_rotvec([alpha,0,0]).as_matrix(); X[0,3]=ai
        Z=np.eye(4); Z[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_rotvec([0,0,qi]).as_matrix(); Z[2,3]=di
        T=T@X@Z
    T[:3,3]+=T[:3,2]*extra
    return T
class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot(); self.spec=self.r.spec(); self.cams=list(self.spec['cameras']); self.i=0; self.samples=[]
        self.obs=self.r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'); self.save('start')
        self.M=np.eye(4);self.M[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',np.pi).as_matrix()
        self.M[:3,3]=self.p[26:29]-self.M[:3,:3]@fk(self.q)[:3,3]
    @property
    def p(self): return np.array(self.obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
    @property
    def q(self): return self.p[4:11]
    def save(self,note):
        dest=ROOT/f'run_{self.i:03d}'; self.obs.save(dest)
        self.samples.append((self.q.copy(),self.p[26:29].copy()))
        (ROOT/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'dir':str(dest),'meta':self.obs.meta},indent=2))
        ims=[Image.fromarray(self.obs.last[c]) for c in self.cams if c in self.obs.last]
        out=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
        for j,im in enumerate(ims):out.paste(im,((j%2)*320,(j//2)*240))
        out.save(ROOT/'latest.jpg')
        print(json.dumps({'i':self.i,'note':note,'q':self.q.tolist(),'eef':self.p[26:29].tolist(),'fingers':self.p[11:13].tolist(),'left':self.obs.meta['time_left_s']}),flush=True);self.i+=1
    def move(self,q=None,n=40,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1,note='move'):
        q=self.q if q is None else np.array(q)
        a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=np.linspace(self.q,q,n)
        a[:,7]=self.p[36] if grip is None else grip
        if base is not None:a[:,8:11]=base
        a[:,11]=torso;a[:,12]=mode
        np.save(ROOT/f'action_{self.i:03d}.npy',a)
        self.obs=self.r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=self.cams,include_depth=True,video='none',note=note)
        self.save(note)
    def fit(self):
        x=np.array([fk(q)[:3,3] for q,p in self.samples]);y=np.array([p for q,p in self.samples]); xc=x-x.mean(0);yc=y-y.mean(0)
        u,s,v=np.linalg.svd(xc.T@yc);R=v.T@u.T
        if np.linalg.det(R)<0:v[-1]*=-1;R=v.T@u.T
        self.M[:3,:3]=R;self.M[:3,3]=y.mean(0)-R@x.mean(0)
        print('FIT',self.M.tolist(),'err',np.linalg.norm((x@R.T+self.M[:3,3])-y,axis=1).tolist(),flush=True)
    def pose(self,q=None):return self.M@fk(self.q if q is None else q)
    def ik(self,p,R=None,qseed=None):
        p=np.array(p);q0=self.q if qseed is None else np.array(qseed)
        def err(q):
            T=self.pose(q);e=(T[:3,3]-p)*10
            if R is not None:e=np.r_[e,Rotation.from_matrix(np.array(R)@T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec()]
            return np.r_[e,(q-q0)*.015]
        sol=least_squares(err,q0,bounds=([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.07,-2.89,-.017,-2.89],[2.89,1.76,2.89,-.069,2.89,3.75,2.89]),max_nfev=200)
        print('IK',sol.x.tolist(),'pose',self.pose(sol.x).tolist(),'err',np.linalg.norm(err(sol.x)[:3]),flush=True)
        return sol.x
    def point(self,cam,u,v):
        d=self.obs.depth[cam]; d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
        z=float(np.median(d[max(0,v-1):v+2,max(0,u-1):u+2]))
        C=self.obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(C['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(C['cam2world_gl']);p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1])
        out=(T@p)[:3];print('POINT',u,v,z,out.tolist(),flush=True);return out
c=Controller()
print('READY',flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        exec(line,globals())
    except Exception as e:
